# Kim Fransman

> Personal site of Kim Fransman: developer with 20+ years in web, mobile, backend, devops and leadership. Golf nerd. Designs and 3D-prints things, sometimes with electronics inside.

The site is a single page. Works mostly with JavaScript, HTML & CSS, React Native and Kotlin Multiplatform.
